native_context: Azure Storage SAS issuance, capability scope and lifetime
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Azure Storage SAS issuance, capability scope and lifetime — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Identify service/account/user-delegation SAS type, issuing principal, exact resource/permissions, validity and applicable revocation mechanism. Inspect authorization before URL issuance.
controls.controlled_verification: With owned synthetic storage, compare a recipient entitled to one object/action with a request to mint a broader token or use it for a different object/action. Record signed scope and actual accepted operation; keep SAS values redacted and avoid unrelated data.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A SAS is designed as a bearer capability. Its presence in a rightful recipient's URL is not a leak by itself. Revocation and stored-access-policy support differ by SAS type.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Narrow issuer authorization, signed resource/permissions and lifetime using the supported type-specific controls. Retest intended access, denied scope and the documented invalidation path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
